statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES / orange. Tail is elevated as the Nasdaq remains strongly higher, while a measurable NQ pullback from the session high and weak broader breadth argue against a high-Tail reading.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. The earlier one-way advance remains relevant, but current evidence shows enough retracement and breadth divergence to place Tail in the elevated rather than high band.
headline: Tail eases to elevated as NQ pulls back from the high while technology stays strong
body: Delayed December NQ is 30,238.50 versus a 30,275.00 session high after a strong cash-session advance. Reuters reported the Nasdaq up 1.62% with broad AI and semiconductor leadership. The roughly 36-point futures pullback from the high and MarketWatch breadth divergence show some mean reversion, reducing Tail from the prior high-band reading.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low through most of Sunday and early Monday, moved to WATCH as NQ strengthened, entered the elevated band before the U.S. cash session, and reached 35% after strong first-hour continuation.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 32% / elevated: technology leadership and the strong index advance remain directional, but NQ has retraced from its session high and broader breadth is weak. Tail re-escalates only if fresh extension resumes with shallow or failed pullbacks; otherwise the base path continues to normalize.
